regions.today: Starting off dull with mist and areas of dense fog, especially over the southern half of the province. While the fog will gradually lift, with some limited brighter spells developing, it may linger into the afternoon in places. It will be a dry day for many further south, but a few patches of rain and drizzle will affect northern parts of the province. Cool with highest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees and just light variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry with just a few coastal showers about, but with dense fog developing in many areas. Chilly with lowest temperatures of 1 to 6 degrees, and just light variable breezes or calm conditions.
regions.tomorrow: Widespread dense fog will gradually lift through the morning, lingering into the afternoon in parts. It will be a dry day for most with some brighter spells developing as the fog clears and just a few coastal showers about. Another cool day with highest temperatures of just 7 to 11 degrees, and light variable breezes.
